messages:
emma: Quick ask — we need a short X + LinkedIn thread to tease the upcoming launch + webinar on May 12. Can we lock copy + assets today?
rafa: I can draft copy. Do we want a benchmark narrative angle (latency/cost) or product-story (what you can build)?
emma: Both, but prioritize benchmark for X carousel and product-story for LinkedIn longpost. Webinar CTA in both.
oliver_design: What image sizes? I can do a GIF for X thread if we want motion. Need final copy + any visual direction.
sara_ops: Also need the webinar calendar link, registration utm, and the tracking pixel for paid posts. Please send UTM values asap.
sam_sdr: Heads up — route webinar signups to HubSpot list "Launch-Webinar-5-12" and ping #sdr-inbound with CSV nightly. Can we add a lead source tag?
kai_analytics: Suggested UTM params: `utm_source=x|linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_2026&utm_content=variantA` — we'll want variantB for the A/B headline. I'll track conversions by utm_content.
emma: Good call. Rafa, can you propose 2 headlines and a short TL;DR for LinkedIn? Keep X copy 2–3 tweets + image captions.
rafa: Drafts below — please react with 👍 to confirm or suggest edits.

1) Headline A (LinkedIn): "Cut inference costs by 2x without sacrificing latency — how we did it."
TL;DR: short bullets + webinar CTA at end.
2) Headline B (LinkedIn): "How engineers are shipping faster LLM features with predictable costs."
X thread (2 variants):
A1: "Benchmark: 2x cost reduction on production workloads. Join our webinar 5/12 to see the setup ->"
A2: "Shipping LLM features should be predictable. Watch our webinar 5/12 for a demo ->"

oliver_design: For X GIF: propose 1200x675 (16:9) for motion card, static 1200x1200 for single image. Need brand-safe frames: logo, product screenshot, simple metric overlay ("2x cost"). Can someone drop the screenshot with annotations?
sara_ops: Calendar link: https://events.redwood.ai/webinar-512 — please append `?utm=launch_2026` or use the UTM above. Pixel details in #ads-ops.

sam_sdr: I'll set HubSpot list and create automation to tag by utm_content. Also will create a Slack webhook to post new registrants to #sdr-inbound. Who wants nightly CSV? @emma?
emma: Yes, send nightly CSV and ping any >100 leads immediately.
kai_analytics: For benchmarking narrative: suggest we include 3 quick metrics in the X carousel slides: baseline latency, optimized latency, cost per 1M tokens. Keeps it snappy.

rafa: Small copy edits: change "2x cost reduction" -> "up to 2x lower infra cost" for honest wording. Also add lines for Q&A time in webinar.

oliver_design: Noted. I'll assemble three slides + GIF frames. ETA 4 hours if I get the screenshots. Who can annotate the screenshot?
sara_ops: I'll export a product screenshot now and drop in the #marketing-assets drive with filename `launch-webinar-screenshot-0512.png`.

rafa: Quick A/B text experiments for X (short form):
- Variant A: "Up to 2x lower infra cost. Live demo + benchmarks May 12. RSVP: <link>"
- Variant B: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency & cost. Demo May 12. RSVP: <link>"

emma: Let's run both as organic posts and boost the better-performing one after 24h. For boosted posts use `utm_content=boost_A` or `boost_B` depending.
kai_analytics: I'll set dashboard to surface CTR and registration rate at +6h, +24h. Also add a cohort for signed-up-from-x vs linkedIn.
sam_sdr: Confirming HubSpot mapping: source=Social, campaign=launch_2026, content=variantA/B. Will share mapping sheet in #marketing.

oliver_design: Dropped initial GIF + static images to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/launch/0512 — please review.
sara_ops: Scheduled the webinar event on the site and connected Zoom. Publish bot will create the social posts once we confirm copy + assets.
publish_bot: scheduled post created — X thread variant A at 2026-05-05T16:00Z, LinkedIn post A at 2026-05-06T09:00Z (pending approval).

emma: Final checklist: 1) approve A/B headlines (rafa) 2) approve images (oliver) 3) confirm UTMs (kai) 4) HubSpot routing (sam) 5) schedule boosts (sara). Please mark done in thread.
rafa: Approved A (with wording tweak).👍
oliver_design: Images good — will update metric overlay per Rafa change.
kai_analytics: UTMs confirmed.
sam_sdr: HubSpot mapping done and webhook set.
sara_ops: I'll queue the boosts after 24h and share budget ask in #ads-ops.

emma: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll post the final copy here shortly and give publish_bot the greenlight.
publish_bot: post queued for final publish after approval reaction from @emma."
